gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.

gaps.sentence: He's a regular ___ (CONTRIBUTE) to the magazine.
The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.

gaps.sentence: The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.
